memory_bridge: Under the chosen roof, first pin a calendar plan 予定 for On テイ, then have the straight foot make the actual decision with 定める for Kun さだめる.

readings.editorial_reason: Promoted because 予定（よてい）is common, modern, and pedagogically useful.
readings.overlay: Pin 予定（よてい）, “plans,” above the roof before choosing it; the final character uses On テイ.

readings.editorial_reason: Promoted because 定める（さだめる）is common, modern, and pedagogically useful.
readings.overlay: Have the straight foot point decisively to one roof and 定める（さだめる） it; the complete native verb fixes Kun さだめる, “to decide.”
